class.name: NetwCodec
class.brief_description: Compact byte codec for tick-stamped state and input payloads.

method.name: decode_payload
method.description: Reads a [code]{ key: value }[/code] payload from [param reader] in [param keys] order.

method.name: decode_snapshot
method.description: Decodes a snapshot blob into [code]{ tick, ack, payload }[/code]. Returns an empty [Dictionary] for empty [param bytes] or for a header whose varint is corrupt.

method.name: decode_value
method.description: Reads a single value written by [method encode_value]. [param type] is the reconstructed [enum Variant.Type] a quantized value needs, ignored on the tagged path.

method.name: decode_window
method.description: Decodes a window blob back into the sample shape. Returns an empty array for empty [param bytes].

method.name: encode_payload
method.description: Writes [param payload] values into [param writer] in [param keys] order.

method.name: encode_snapshot
method.description: Encodes [param tick], [param ack], and [param payload] into a snapshot blob. Both header fields are zigzag varints, so an [param ack] of [code]-1[/code] costs one byte.

method.name: encode_value
method.description: Writes a single [param value] into [param writer], bit-packed by [param quantizer] when set, otherwise byte-aligned with a type tag. The public entry to the value-encoding core, shared by entity RPC arguments.

method.name: encode_window
method.description: Encodes a tick-ascending window of [code]{ tick, input }[/code] samples. Returns an empty array for an empty window.

method.name: get_safe_varint
method.description: Reads a varint from [param reader], returning [code]-1[/code] on overflow or a corrupt packet.

method.name: put_varint
method.description: Writes [param value] as a varint into [param writer].

method.name: read_values
method.description: Reads the positional row [method write_values] wrote: as many values as [param reader] carries kind bytes for, each decoded by its own kind and, where [param quantizers] and [param types] named one, its packed encoding.

method.name: write_values
method.description: Writes a positional row whose values describe themselves. A declared schema is what lets a row leave its types off the wire, and a caller here has none: these are the rows a stock synchronizer config and an RPC argument list produce, where the shape is whatever the game put on the node. So each value carries its own kind byte, and [param quantizers] and [param types] only decide whether a value may be PACKED rather than what it is. A node crosses as its own kind rather than as a value, because a [Node] cannot be serialized and the receiver holds a different instance of it.

constants.constant: Any type the packed tags do not cover, written as a length-prefixed [method @GlobalScope.var_to_bytes] blob.
An [int], written as eight little-endian bytes.
